messages:
customer_acme: Hey team — after the rollout last night (r-2026-03-16) our app started seeing the model skip calling our fetch_invoice tool. It used to call the tool and return a structured result, now it returns a free-text summary instead. Repro below.

customer_acme: Repro request (sanitized):
```json
{
  \"route\": \"/v1/chat/completions\",
  \"model\": \"redwood-chat-v2\",
  \"messages\": [
    { \"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Please retrieve invoice INV-1234 using the fetch_invoice tool and return JSON with fields id, total, items.\" }
  ],
  \"tools\": [
    {\"name\": \"fetch_invoice\", \"input_schema\": {\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"invoice_id\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}}
  ]
}```

customer_acme: Expected assistant to call tool: {\"tool\":\"fetch_invoice\",\"args\":{\"invoice_id\":\"INV-1234\"}} but got: 
```
Assistant: Sure — the invoice INV-1234 has a balance of $1,234.56. Itemized breakdown: ...
```

customer_acme: This started immediately after the control plane rollout at 23:11Z. We have many production failures; can you advise? :frowning:

support_jen: Sorry about that — we see the escalation. Can you paste one request_id and the short ISO ts for one failing request? We'll fetch the server-side logs.

customer_acme: request_id: acme-req-2026-03-16T23:42:10Z, region: us-west-2, tenant: acme-inc. Model header shows redwood-chat-v2@2026-03-16.

mike: Thanks, grabbing logs now. Quick Q: is the tool schema nested or do you pass the args as plain string? Any change in how you call tools?

customer_acme: No change on our side — same client code. We verified with a curl that used to produce a tool call on 2026-03-15.

mike: Found log snippet for request acme-req-2026-03-16T23:42:10Z:
```
[2026-03-16T23:42:10Z] request_id=acme-req-2026-03-16T23:42:10Z model=redwood-chat-v2 route=/v1/chat/completions input_tokens=34
[...]
decision: toolcall | candidate_actions=1 | tool_required=true | selected_action=NONE | reason=policy_fallback
metrics.toolcall.missed=1
```
mike: The runtime reported selected_action=NONE despite tool_required=true. That suggests the selector refused the toolcall path. I'm checking the rollout notes.

deploy-bot: Deploy r-2026-03-16 promoted to prod at 2026-03-16T23:11:07Z by @sam (traffic: canary->100% during staged flip).

sam: We pushed a change to the routing/selector config in r-2026-03-16 that tightens compatibility checks for tool schemas (we added stricter validation of args). Could be related.

engineer_lee: If the selector is rejecting a toolcall due to schema mismatch, we should see validation failures in the model decision trace. Can you share the full decision trace for that request (we can request it from logs if you can't).

support_jen: For now, customer_acme — two options: 1) we can temporarily route your traffic to the previous variant (rollback) while we investigate, or 2) provide the exact failing request payload and we will fetch the decision trace. Which do you prefer?

customer_acme: Can you rollback? This is blocking our invoices flow. We'll send the full payload now. Thanks.

support_jen: Rolling back your tenant to r-2026-03-15 variant for the next 30m and opening a P1. You'll get a support ticket with the privilege log link.

mike: Follow-up: once we have the decision trace, we should confirm if the stricter validator rejects args when optional fields are missing or when types are coerced. Also checking if the toolmapper micro-change flattened nested keys.

engineer_lee: Noted — if we reproduced locally we can add a compatibility shim to accept the older shape. Will update in this thread. :thumbsup:

customer_acme: Appreciate the quick action. We'll monitor and report if anything else pops up.
